span.span: Boot /app/alpine.iso in QEMU and start an SSH server inside the VM. The user should be able to connect with ssh -p 2222 root@localhost using the password password123.
Reasoning Content: “First, I should check if QEMU is installed and if the ISO file exists.”
Main work: The agent launches QEMU with host port 2222 forwarded to guest port 22. The first launch leaves a stopped QEMU job.
Reasoning Content: “The VM has started but seems to have stopped. Let me try a different approach.”
